metadata.notes: Integration-authored PLAYER bindings. NPC source wording remains unchanged except four explicitly integration-authored paired_greet.wellbeing.*.content variants appended to farmer_new_greeting_rows. This is an ordinary Greet slice, not a new menu or dialogue owner. No source-pool conversion credit is claimed. First/familiar means recorded contact only; no first-ever meeting, journey or elapsed-time claim. Names require actual known names; plain alternatives are provided.
metadata.source_reference: Farmer-existing-greetings-and-jokes-rewrite.txt and retained farmer.base.greeting_ordinary.* variants; Shared-ordinary-first-record-and-ominous-greetings-expanded-pools.txt relationship/contact constraints. Farmer wellbeing source is NPC-to-player and is NOT the source of authored player-to-NPC wellbeing replies.
metadata.unpaired_reason: Original variants remain unchanged and selectable. Their weather, proximity, recent work, location or encounter premises are not certified by this paired slice; no authored player opener is bound to them.
metadata.authored_style: Only the integration-authored Trusted/content wellbeing answer colors content with the already-supported aqua tag. Original source text has no new markup. No camera overrides.
metadata.npc_text_guard: npc_text is the exact visible DialogueResult.text() guard, with supported style tags removed. Authored NPC textSegments retain the aqua styling.
metadata.player_style: Natural tier-sensitive salutations, no narrated speech-act descriptions, promises, threats, apologies or inferred biography.
metadata.optional_tokens: Context-gated <time_greeting> alternatives and familiar actual-known-name <villager> alternatives supplement plain alternatives; no unguarded clock, visit-history or name claims.
